claims: Robert Mueller died on Friday night, March 20, 2026.
Robert Mueller died in Charlottesville, Virginia.
Robert Mueller's family did not specify an exact cause of death.
Robert Mueller's family previously disclosed he was diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease in 2021.
Robert Mueller had been facing escalating health issues.
Robert Mueller's cause of death is Parkinson's disease.
Robert Mueller served as FBI Director from 2001 to 2013.
Robert Mueller served as Special Counsel investigating Russian interference in the 2016 election from 2017 to 2019.
Robert Mueller is survived by his wife, Ann Cabell Standish.
